name: Drinking water treatment; conventional UV lamp
description:
This unit process reflects  material inputs required for the production of conventional UV lamps (bulbs) used in drinking water treatment. 

The process is normalized to the functional unit of  1 item, weighing 321 grams.
category: 22: Utilities/2213: Water, Sewage and Other Systems

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Data originally published in 2004. Data collection period unknown.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Inventory exchange values were sourced directly from the cited EPA report on disinfection options in municipal drinking water treatment. Background data sources have, in some cases, been updated to reflect newer and/or public data sources. Elementary flows were mapped to the federal elementary flow list.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Infrastructure end-of-life treatment/disposal is excluded. Some relevant flows not captured. The mass balance for this process was not calculated.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Data was sourced from pre-existing LCA, which is no longer available. The inventory is documented in the cited EPA report.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: This item is standardized to the functional unit by dividing the inventory value by the quantity of water treated over the lifespan of the infrastructure component. Each lamp treats 3.6 million gallons per day and has a lifetime of 8000 hours.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Scope: material inputs. Some relevant flows not captured. Uncertainty ranges are not available for this data.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data originally published in 2004. Data collection period unknown.
processDocumentation.useAdvice: This item can be standardized to the functional unit by dividing the inventory value by the quantity of water treated over the lifespan of the infrastructure component. Each lamp treats 3.6 million gallons per day and has a lifetime of 8000 hours.

sources.name: Xue et al (2019) LCA of Urban Water Systems

reviews.details:
Proof reading details: Passed
Other details: none

processDocumentation.intendedApplication:
"This is an infrastructure process used in the development of drinking water LCI data, which is intended to be used as a background process by LCA practitioners, industry and the general public.

Situation C2 - Accounting, without system-external interatctions. The intended application is a purely descriptive accounting / documentation of the analysed system excluding existing interactions with other systems in the LCI model."
processDocumentation.projectDescription: Data were prepared by Eastern Research Group (ERG) on behalf of the U.S. EPA under Contract No. EP-C-12-021, "Environmental and Cost Life Cycle Assessment of Disinfection Options for Municipal Drinking Water Treatment"
